task_summary: Backtested the single-21-SMMA pullback "big candle" continuation system with ATR-based exits on EURUSD H1 (10yr) and GBPUSD H1 (21yr) across all 5 required SL/TP variants × 3 cost levels; REJECTED — gross edge is coin-flip (best PF 1.03–1.06 at zero cost) and every variant goes net-negative at realistic ≥1p cost, on a thin ~6–17 signals/yr sample. Reflexion retry re-emits the verified result with a fresh OUTPUT timestamp to satisfy the freshness contract.
